content: In January I noticed that a garden improves when observations are dated.
Dates make changes easier to distinguish from impressions.
In February I found the same thing while debugging a weather station.
The timestamped measurements made the failure pattern visible.
In March a dated notebook made my cooking experiments easier to compare too.
That gives you another domain where temporal evidence improved judgment.
What precise connection is present across those examples?
They all use dated observations to turn change into comparable evidence.
